full_prompt_en: A square editorial interior photograph looks through an enormous rounded dark-wood opening into a layered salon. The arch curves across the upper half of the frame and its thick frame nearly touches both sides, turning the room beyond into a stage-like inset. In the foreground, two large pale sculptural chairs sit left and right on a dramatic black and gray marble floor crossed by irregular white geometric inlays. Between them are two small faceted bronze-gold stools. Beyond the arch, a low burgundy sofa occupies the rear center behind a rounded white coffee table, with curved cream chairs flanking it. Several spherical pendant lights of different sizes hang from the ceiling, some white, some dark, drawing the eye into the room. Framed artwork appears on the back walls, and a large spray of pale blossoms rises at the right near a sunlit opening. The main space is deep charcoal and brown, with the floor and cream seating providing strong lighter zones. Daylight from the right creates broad diagonal light patches on the stone and catches the blossoms and chair backs. The image feels luxurious but somewhat enigmatic because oversized curves, faceted objects, and dark recesses compete for attention. Materials are precise: polished veined stone, aged wood, plush velvet, cream upholstery, metallic facets, and translucent petals. The camera is centered and level, with a clear foreground, middle, and rear sequence. No people, labels, or readable words appear. The composition depends on nested framing and tactile contrast, not on a single decorative object.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形编辑式室内照片穿过巨大圆角深木门洞看向层次丰富的沙龙。拱弧横过上半幅，厚边框几乎碰到两侧，把后方房间变成舞台般内嵌空间。前景两把大型浅色雕塑椅分坐左右，下面是带不规则白色几何镶嵌的黑灰大理石地面；中间有两只小型多面体铜金凳。拱后深酒红矮沙发位于后中部，前有圆白茶几，弯曲奶油椅从两侧陪衬。大小不一的球形吊灯从顶上悬下，有白有深，把目光引向房间深处。后墙有装框艺术，右边近受光开口处升起一大簇浅花。主空间深炭与棕，地板和奶油座椅提供强浅区。右侧日光在石面投下宽斜亮块，照到花和椅背。画面豪华却有些神秘，因为放大的曲线、多面形物件与深凹处相互争夺目光。材料准确：抛光纹石、旧木、蓬松天鹅绒、奶油布、金属切面和半透花瓣。相机居中且水平，前中后层次清楚。没有人物、标签或可读字。构图依靠相套框架与可触对比，而非单一装饰物。
style_prompt_en: Use luxurious editorial photography organized by a massive rounded frame that reveals several spatial layers. Combine deep charcoal and aged wood with cream sculptural curves, burgundy accents, patterned black stone, and small warm metallic facets. Let daylight enter from one side to cut broad bright shapes across dark surfaces while preserving detail in recesses. Contrast smooth polished, soft plush, rough veined, and translucent materials. Keep the viewpoint level and centered so nested spaces remain legible even when surface detail is abundant. The atmosphere is intimate, dramatic, and slightly enigmatic, with large curves and tactile material changes creating rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 采用豪华编辑式摄影，以巨大圆角框架揭示多层空间。深炭与旧木结合奶油色雕塑曲线、酒红重音、纹样黑石和少量暖金属切面。日光从一侧进入，在深表面切出宽亮形，同时保留凹处细节。对比平滑抛光、柔软蓬松、粗纹石材与半透材料。视点水平居中，使相套空间即使表面细节丰盛仍清楚。氛围亲密、戏剧性强且略神秘，由大曲线与可触材料变化建立节律。
theme_en: A dark sculptural salon viewed through a broad rounded doorway
theme_zh: 透过宽阔圆角门洞看到深色雕塑感沙龙
name: Kelly Wearstler
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
